findings.name: Sultanate of Delhi
findings.note: The source attribution in 1200 predates the sultanate established in 1206; the Lodi sultanate ended with Babur’s conquest in 1526.

sources.title: Delhi Sultanate: Political and cultural history

findings.name: Seljuk Caliphate
findings.note: This source label lies in Anatolia and denotes the Seljuq Sultanate of Rum, not a caliphate. Its last dynastic phase ended in 1307/1308; the source’s 1400 appearance is anachronistic. No successor border is invented.

sources.title: The Art of the Seljuq Period in Anatolia (1081–1307)

findings.name: Inca Empire
findings.note: The imperial overview ends after the 1532 conquest watershed. This intentionally does not reuse empire-wide borders for the distinct Vilcabamba resistance state (1536–1572).

findings.name: Benin
findings.note: Applies only to source observations through 1900 for the Benin kingdom in present-day Nigeria; never to modern Republic of Benin.

sources.title: British Museum collection record: British occupation of Benin City in 1897

findings.name: Manchu Empire
findings.note: Revolution in 1911 and abdication in early 1912. Conservative end-of-year bound; no claim that imperial control remained intact throughout 1912.

meaning: Negative chronology checks over all world source observations; passing a guard does not independently verify a state or boundary. Source metadata and geometry remain unchanged. Compiled with the exhaustive study coverage index.
